portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Weak breadth, falling credit and duration assets, and a recent Fed hike make indiscriminate dip-buying unattractive. Inflation and expansionary manufacturing readings provide some independent support for commodity-related pullbacks, but not a strong oil-specific catalyst. The crowded release calendar makes modest, uncertain reversal edges more credible than extrapolating technology leadership. Mechanical three-session returns and five-session active returns are treated as distinct measurements.
